review_scope: shufflePosition_comm from Nat.max_comm; shuffleFlip_shares_position uses shuffleFlip_involutive to show a value and its flip share position; shuffleFlip_shares_bit_index carries the equality through shuffleBitByteIndex.
shuffleFlip_inj: shuffleFlip is injective on {v : v < count} — apply flip twice on both sides via shuffleFlip_involutive.
shuffleStep_eq: rewriting shuffleStep as shuffleSwapOrNot idx flip (bit at position) — pure rfl unfolding.

shuffleStep_pair: for a value idx < count and its flip f = shuffleFlip pivot count idx, the pair either both keep (step idx = idx AND step f = f) or both swap (step idx = f AND step f = idx). Proof splits on the swap bit bit % 2 = 1 using the shared position hypothesis (bit is the same for idx and f).

shuffleStep_inj: one inner-loop step is injective on indices < count. Two-way case analysis on shuffleStep_pair for v and w; when the keep/swap patterns disagree, use shuffleFlip_involutive to derive w = shuffleFlip … v, then combine with the corresponding shuffleStep value; when both swap, use shuffleFlip_inj.

Concrete injectivity example: samplePairDigest = [3] ++ replicate 24 0 (length 32; Hash32Like) — shuffleStep samplePairHash [] 0 8 1 ≠ shuffleStep samplePairHash [] 0 8 2 by decide (real step preserves distinctness).
Bit-at-index mutant refuted: shuffleStepAtIndex (indexing the bit by idx not position) collides at (1, 2) under the same digest — kills a byte-index location mutant.
shuffleRoundApply = map shuffleStep (phase0:1208-1219): length preservation, elementwise < count preservation, and Nodup preservation via nodup_map_on + shuffleStep_inj.
identityPerm_nodup / identityPerm_lt: List.range n is Nodup and every element < n.

shufflePermutation = foldl shuffleRoundApply over the 90 rounds starting from identityPerm n. foldl_shuffleRoundApply_length / _lt / _nodup each induct on the round list; shufflePermutation_length = n; shufflePermutation_lt v : v < n; shufflePermutation_nodup: the 90-round walk output stays Nodup.
Three new #print axioms mutants: shuffle_flip_shares_position (concrete decide), shuffle_bit_at_index_collides (byte-index mutant collides), shuffle_step_partners_distinct (real step distinguishes).
